replacements.La mitad superior muestra cómo un prefij: The upper half shows how a prefix is identified and looked up in cache, taking either a hit branch that reuses verified KV or a miss branch that performs prefill before both paths rejoin at the uncached suffix. The lower half shows a proposer generating candidates that the target verifies, accepts, or rejects; rejected state is rewound before the next state is committed. Both mechanisms put pressure on KV capacity and the scheduler.

replacements.<strong>Lectura:</strong> prefix caching: Reading: prefix caching can only skip work that already produced compatible KV state.
